comment: Proposed least-privilege replacement for live Sid StagingSesSend on checksops-staging-ApiFunctionRole-7E7XRyLe3nyi. NOT ATTACHED. Do not PutRolePolicy in this PR. Code uses SES v1 SendEmailCommand only; SendRawEmail is unused.
notes: ses:SendRawEmail is omitted because sendViaSesOrSink uses SendEmailCommand only and does not attach files.
Identity-scoped ses:SendEmail is valid for SES v1 when Source belongs to that verified identity.
Platform From noreply@checksops.com would then IAM-fail, which is intended while the staging send test is locked to the C1C ses-gate identity.
Do not attach this policy until AWS_EMAIL_MODE=ses is separately approved, AWS_EMAIL_SES_LOCK_RECIPIENT is set to exactly one address, and queued mail is confirmed empty.
Keep existing ses:CreateEmailIdentity / ses:GetEmailIdentity identity APIs unchanged for ses-identity mode.
